purpose: Deterministic health contract for root entry points and the curated Korean-to-English context queue.

translation.batching: PostToolUse queues changed Korean mirrors; Stop translates the sorted unique batch once
translation.failure_policy: Preserve existing outputs and retain the queue for retry

safety.curated_mirrors: Files under .users/context are human-curated. The batch hook updates only their English counterparts after a hash-detected change.
safety.mechanical_mirrors: AUTO-GENERATED sources are excluded from LLM translation. A prior managed translation is retired if its source becomes mechanical; unrelated English-only files without receipts are preserved.
